name: Consolidate Agentic Workflow Discussions
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  consolidate-discussions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Update audit-workflows.md category
        run: |
          sed -i 's/category: "q-a"/category: "agentic-workflows"/' audit-workflows.md

      - name: Update portfolio-analyst.md category
        run: |
          sed -i 's/category: Audits/category: "agentic-workflows"/' portfolio-analyst.md

      - name: Recompile lock files
        run: |
          # Placeholder for recompilation step
          echo "Recompiling lock files..."
          # Add actual recompilation commands as needed

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Consolidate agentic workflow discussions to single category" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Setup GitHub Agentic Workflows
        uses: github/gh-aw/actions/setup@32b3a711a9ee97d38e3989c90af0385aff0066a7
        with:
          destination: ./agentic-workflows
          safe-output-custom-tokens: true

      - name: Run opencode
        uses: anomalyco/opencode/github@latest
        with:
          model: gpt-4
          agent: agentic-workflows
          share: false
          prompt: "Ensure all agentic workflows that write discussions, write them to the Agentic Workflows group"
          use_github_token: true
          variant: default
